scope: All M and S requirements, explicitly requested by the project owner
externalConfiguration: No email, payment, hosting, malware scan, OCR or AI provider has been selected yet. Provider activation is not represented by a mock passing.

requirements.title: Authentication, account recovery, invitations, and MFA
requirements.acceptance: Invitations expire after a configured period and are single-use; administrative and approval accounts require MFA; recovery does not disclose whether an email exists
requirements.remaining: Email recovery/verification delivery, recovery abuse controls and full identity lifecycle acceptance remain pending.

requirements.title: Manage tenants, entities, and memberships
requirements.acceptance: A user cannot access an unauthorized entity, including by changing a request identifier
requirements.remaining: Remaining workspace lifecycle, ownership transfer and full SRS acceptance remain pending.

requirements.title: Enforce action and data permissions
requirements.acceptance: Unauthorized viewing, downloading, editing, and approval are blocked, with every access path tested
requirements.remaining: Export, worker and integration access paths require implementation and independent authorization tests.

requirements.title: Configure fiscal year, currency, calendar, and bank accounts
requirements.acceptance: Settings affecting a locked version cannot change without a new version and an impact plan
requirements.remaining: Acceptance must be exercised against the completed backend; schema existence alone is not completion.

requirements.title: Manage accounting periods and locks
requirements.acceptance: A locked period rejects direct changes; reopening requires authorization and a reason and creates a new version
requirements.remaining: Acceptance must be exercised against the completed backend; schema existence alone is not completion.

requirements.title: Upload XLSX and CSV with type, size, and malware checks
requirements.acceptance: Invalid or infected files are rejected; analysis starts only after checks pass; file content is not executed
requirements.remaining: Encrypted typed upload and fail-closed scan jobs work. Real scanner deployment/benign-malicious/archive acceptance, isolated parsing and replacing legacy pre-scan draft analysis remain pending.

requirements.title: Preview worksheets and rows and map columns
requirements.acceptance: The user selects the worksheet, header row, date format, and decimal separator; transformed values are previewed before confirmation
requirements.remaining: The scoped preview API and UI are wired. Live acceptance requires a real scanner and local Docker engine for end-to-end scan, isolated execution and mapped preview.

requirements.title: Save versioned import templates
requirements.acceptance: Reuse detects changes to required columns and requests review instead of silently remapping
requirements.remaining: Scoped persistence, immutable versions and reuse with drift rejection are wired and exercised with fixtures. Live save and reuse after a real scan and isolated preview remain pending.

requirements.title: Import trial balances, general ledgers, and bank-account ledgers
requirements.acceptance: Mandatory fields are validated for each file type, and errors identify source row numbers
requirements.remaining: Complete selected sheets can be staged and validated. Trial balance, general ledger, bank statement and bank ledger publish into immutable typed datasets. Live scan-to-import and large-file acceptance remain pending.

requirements.title: Detect duplicates and overlapping periods
requirements.acceptance: Re-uploading the same file does not duplicate data; similar records are flagged without automatically deleting legitimate transactions
requirements.remaining: Acceptance must be exercised against the completed backend; schema existence alone is not completion.

requirements.title: Produce a data-quality report
requirements.acceptance: Blocking errors and warnings are separate; record counts, rejection reasons, and totals before and after exclusions are shown
requirements.remaining: Review displays blocking issues, warnings, counts and exact totals before and after exclusions. Live acceptance with scanned files and broader quality rules remain pending.

requirements.title: Correct and map data without altering the original
requirements.acceptance: Original values, changes, actor, and reason are retained; affected validations and calculations rerun
requirements.remaining: Scoped draft corrections preserve encrypted originals, append actor and reason history and rerun row and batch validation. Typed output recalculation and live acceptance remain pending.

requirements.title: Manage asynchronous processing jobs
requirements.acceptance: Progress, failure, and cancellation are visible; retries do not duplicate imports or outputs
requirements.remaining: Scan-job leases, fencing, retries, cancellation and suspension revocation work. Reliable import/parser/export job lifecycle and production monitoring/recovery/load acceptance remain pending.

requirements.title: Extract text PDFs and images through OCR
requirements.acceptance: Critical financial fields and low-confidence pages are reviewed; OCR scores alone cannot authorize approval
requirements.remaining: Acceptance must be exercised against the completed backend; schema existence alone is not completion.

requirements.title: Map accounts to reporting line items
requirements.acceptance: Every unmapped account is visible; splitting an account across line items requires a rule that defines totals and prevents duplication
requirements.remaining: Published trial balances generate a frozen mapping with one validated classification per account. Editable mapping policies, documented splits and live acceptance remain pending.

requirements.title: Produce an income statement and statement of financial position
requirements.acceptance: Results match ground truth; approval is blocked if balance, mapping, or scope validations fail
requirements.remaining: Published, balanced trial balances generate versioned drafts with passed validations. Independent approval using live scanned sources and broader ground-truth coverage remain pending.

requirements.title: Present comparisons and variances
requirements.acceptance: Period, currency, entity scope, and policies are disclosed; zero denominators do not generate misleading percentages
requirements.remaining: Acceptance must be exercised against the completed backend; schema existence alone is not completion.

requirements.title: Calculate financial metrics
requirements.acceptance: Each metric shows its formula, contributing accounts, and period; missing required inputs produce “Unavailable”
requirements.remaining: Versioned ratio formulas produce exact values or explicit unavailable reasons. Broader KPI coverage and account-level metric navigation remain pending.

requirements.title: Trace figures to source data
requirements.acceptance: Reviewers can navigate from a line item to available accounts, transactions, or trial-balance rows; the interface does not imply unavailable transaction detail
requirements.remaining: Statement lines link to original source rows and the specific correction applied. Linked ledger transaction drill-down and live acceptance remain pending.

requirements.title: Detect exceptions through explainable rules
requirements.acceptance: Alerts show the rule, threshold, and affected data; exceptions are not labeled as proven fraud
requirements.remaining: Acceptance must be exercised against the completed backend; schema existence alone is not completion.

requirements.title: Generate numerical analysis and rule-based explanations
requirements.acceptance: Each quantitative statement links to a calculated metric; arithmetic changes are distinguished from causal explanations
requirements.remaining: Acceptance must be exercised against the completed backend; schema existence alone is not completion.

requirements.title: Prepare a statement of cash flows
requirements.acceptance: Approval requires sufficient supporting data, complete classifications, and reconciliation of cash
requirements.remaining: Acceptance must be exercised against the completed backend; schema existence alone is not completion.

requirements.title: Provide optional AI-assisted narrative
requirements.acceptance: The model cannot alter figures or matches; claims link to sources, and unsupported statements are prevented
requirements.remaining: Acceptance must be exercised against the completed backend; schema existence alone is not completion.

requirements.title: Compare budgets and cost centers
requirements.acceptance: Dimensions, periods, and currencies must be compatible; non-comparable items are disclosed
requirements.remaining: Acceptance must be exercised against the completed backend; schema existence alone is not completion.

requirements.title: Create a reconciliation for an account, currency, and cutoff date
requirements.acceptance: Mixed accounts or currencies are blocked; overlapping reconciliations trigger a warning; opening and closing balance versions are identified
requirements.remaining: Acceptance must be exercised against the completed backend; schema existence alone is not completion.

requirements.title: Normalize bank and book signs and validate balances
requirements.acceptance: Opening balance plus transactions reconciles to closing balance; inconsistent sign interpretation is not accepted
requirements.remaining: Acceptance must be exercised against the completed backend; schema existence alone is not completion.

requirements.title: Confirm one-to-one matches using approved rules
requirements.acceptance: Automatic confirmation requires a unique candidate meeting all rule conditions; the reason and rule version are recorded
requirements.remaining: Acceptance must be exercised against the completed backend; schema existence alone is not completion.

requirements.title: Suggest matches using date, description, and reference
requirements.acceptance: Amounts, dates, evidence, and conflicts are shown; ambiguous cases require review
requirements.remaining: Acceptance must be exercised against the completed backend; schema existence alone is not completion.

requirements.title: Suggest one-to-many and many-to-one matches
requirements.acceptance: Group members, total, and residual are shown; groups are not automatically approved at launch
requirements.remaining: Manual one-to-many and many-to-one work; bounded rule-driven grouped suggestion search and sum/residual display still need acceptance.

requirements.title: Support partial matching and allocation
requirements.acceptance: Total allocations cannot exceed a transaction’s amount; the unallocated balance remains visible

requirements.title: Manually accept, reject, and unmatch
requirements.acceptance: User and reason are recorded; overriding a clear reference conflict requires a reason and supervisor permission
requirements.remaining: Accept/reject/unmatch and supervisor override APIs work; complete administration and review-facing workflow acceptance remains.

requirements.title: Classify differences and attach evidence
requirements.acceptance: Each item has a type, status, owner, amount, sign, reconciliation effect, and supporting source
requirements.remaining: Independent scanned evidence upload/download and full item correction/ownership lifecycle remain pending.

requirements.title: Prepare the reconciliation statement and proposed entries
requirements.acceptance: Both adjusted balances and the residual difference are calculated; no posted entry is created and source records remain unchanged
requirements.remaining: Imported-entry linking, full proposal lifecycle and independently validated published reconciliation acceptance remain pending.

requirements.title: Carry forward outstanding items and track their age
requirements.acceptance: Each item retains its identity and origination date; duplicate inclusion and reuse of previously reconciled transactions are prevented
requirements.remaining: Guarded carry-forward is implemented; successful real scanned/approved prior-period carry-forward and imported-entry double-count prevention require end-to-end acceptance.

requirements.title: Display matching coverage and result quality
requirements.acceptance: Counts, absolute values, and denominators are shown; coverage is distinguished from precision, which requires ground truth
requirements.remaining: Exact count/absolute-value coverage and unavailable precision are implemented; independent ground truth, sample methodology, confidence intervals and quality-report acceptance remain pending.

requirements.title: Support review, approval, and rejection
requirements.acceptance: Preparers cannot approve their own version; approval fails if critical validation fails or the version changed after submission
requirements.remaining: Independent approval and locking work for published financial statements and fully matched bank reconciliations in rollback fixtures. Live scan-to-approval, reconciliation with differences, and complete period-version lifecycle remain pending.

requirements.title: Freeze approved versions and document reopening
requirements.acceptance: Previous versions remain retrievable; new versions explain their reason and differences
requirements.remaining: Acceptance must be exercised against the completed backend; schema existence alone is not completion.

requirements.title: Export PDF and XLSX
requirements.acceptance: Values match the selected version; entity, period, currency, status, version, and generation date are displayed
requirements.remaining: Acceptance must be exercised against the completed backend; schema existence alone is not completion.

requirements.title: Support comments, attachments, and notifications
requirements.acceptance: Comments link to an object and version; email notifications do not contain financial files or sensitive data by default
requirements.remaining: Acceptance must be exercised against the completed backend; schema existence alone is not completion.

requirements.title: Provide a searchable, exportable audit trail
requirements.acceptance: Imports, edits, matching, approval, downloads, and permission changes are recorded; client users cannot modify the trail
requirements.remaining: Acceptance must be exercised against the completed backend; schema existence alone is not completion.

requirements.title: Manage plans, billing, and usage quotas
requirements.acceptance: Limits are enforced before jobs start; duplicate payment events do not duplicate subscriptions or invoices; capacity rejection reasons are shown
requirements.remaining: Acceptance must be exercised against the completed backend; schema existence alone is not completion.

requirements.title: Export, delete, and retain client data
requirements.acceptance: Request authority and scope are verified; policies cover originals, derivatives, indexes, and providers
requirements.remaining: Acceptance must be exercised against the completed backend; schema existence alone is not completion.

requirements.title: Manage support requests and temporary access
requirements.acceptance: Support cannot access financial content without time-limited, scoped authorization; access is logged
requirements.remaining: Acceptance must be exercised against the completed backend; schema existence alone is not completion.

requirements.title: Connect accounting systems in read-only mode
requirements.acceptance: Permissions are restricted to granted scope; resynchronization does not duplicate records, and source-update conflicts are visible
requirements.remaining: Acceptance must be exercised against the completed backend; schema existence alone is not completion.

requirements.title: Provide external APIs and webhooks
requirements.acceptance: Authentication, scopes, authorization, rate limits, signatures, replay prevention, and idempotency keys are enforced
requirements.remaining: Acceptance must be exercised against the completed backend; schema existence alone is not completion.

nonFunctional.title: Availability
nonFunctional.acceptance: 99.9% monthly for core workflow interfaces; the service agreement defines measurement and exclusions
nonFunctional.remaining: Requires measured operational acceptance, not a configuration claim.

nonFunctional.title: Response time
nonFunctional.acceptance: p95 ≤2 seconds for ordinary reads and ≤3 seconds for saves under the workload; upload and background processing excluded
nonFunctional.remaining: Requires measured operational acceptance, not a configuration claim.

nonFunctional.title: Report processing
nonFunctional.acceptance: A standard 100,000-row file reaches draft report within 5 minutes at p95, including queue wait but excluding upload and review
nonFunctional.remaining: Requires measured operational acceptance, not a configuration claim.

nonFunctional.title: Reconciliation processing
nonFunctional.acceptance: One-to-one matching at the workload limit completes within 10 minutes at p95; grouped search has a separate resource budget and discloses unsearched cases
nonFunctional.remaining: Requires measured operational acceptance, not a configuration claim.

nonFunctional.title: Calculation correctness
nonFunctional.acceptance: All mandatory accounting reference cases pass; amounts agree at currency precision, with no hidden unexplained difference

nonFunctional.title: Matching precision
nonFunctional.acceptance: ≥99.5% on an independent representative dataset, reporting sample size, strata, and confidence interval; zero critical errors under the approved definition
nonFunctional.remaining: Requires measured operational acceptance, not a configuration claim.

nonFunctional.title: Isolation

nonFunctional.title: Recovery

nonFunctional.title: Job reliability
